summary: Our Bond, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose an extension of an unsecured revolving note with a related party shareholder. The note, originally entered in July 2023 and amended, allows borrowings up to $3 million at the Applicable Federal Rate. The current balance is $0. The maturity date was extended from July 5, 2026 to July 7, 2027. This is a routine financing arrangement with no special situation implications such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is purely administrative, ensuring continued access to low-interest unsecured financing.
